decisions.label: Clear in front of runestones
decisions.note: Ed, 2026-10-26: "we might want this for other important points of interest, such as runestone areas, finds, flasks". On: within reveal.runestone.radius metres of an area's runestone, on the ground, the trees and scenery in front of the stone and its fight's open middle fade away (render/view/reveal.ts), as they do in a legend's circle. Off as built.

decisions.label: Clear in front of the find
decisions.note: On: near tonight's trunk or wreck (within reveal.find.radius metres, until it's taken), the scenery in front of it fades away. Off as built.

decisions.label: Clear in front of flasks
decisions.note: On: near a relic flask lying in the woods (within reveal.flask.radius metres), the scenery in front of it fades away. Off as built.
